system.description:
Also called Rayzeel's Song by Salubri outside a strong Christian or Judaic tradition, this power lets the Salubri's singing or playing help patients heal better, forget physical pain, escape depression, or assist another healer at work. Rayzeel is said to have created this power to draw Saulot out of his depression following the Baali Wars.

System: The music must suit the situation. The Salubri plays or sings; the player rolls Charisma + Music (difficulty 7). If accompanied, both players roll; a botch by the accompanist removes a success for each 1 rolled. If used to draw someone from depression, each success lowers the difficulty of the target's Willpower roll (no lower than 5) or grants 10 minutes of clear thought. If performed before a healing, each success lowers the difficulty of the healing roll by one (no lower than 4, or 5 against a Derangement). If working alongside a doctor, midwife, or another Salubri, each success grants the second healer an additional die on their Medicine/Valeren roll, to a maximum of five bonus dice. Failure adds +1 difficulty to anything attempted afterward; a botch adds +2, may inflict a level of non-aggravated damage as the patient thrashes, may force a frenzy or Rötschreck roll if treating a Derangement, and may draw supernatural attention to the disharmony.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
